items.text: Seattle is sticking with Sam Darnold (not on the report); Drew Lock (elbow) was limited. The schedule data lists Lock, so the model uses Darnold.
Kansas City LT Josh Simmons went to IR Thursday (back).
Chiefs WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) and RT Jaylon Moore (concussion) did not practice Wednesday; Travis Kelce (ankle) and CB L'Jarius Sneed limited; Patrick Mahomes full.
Seattle LBs Drake Thomas and Chazz Surratt did not practice Wednesday; RB Zach Charbonnet was activated and practiced fully.

adjust.reason: Kansas City may be without both starting tackles plus Rashee Rice, while Seattle's absences are mostly linebackers. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
